plan.instruction: The user requests to exclude one fiscal year from the existing NVIDIA FY2024-FY2026 Revenue Chart. Since the user did not specify which year to exclude (FY2024, FY2025, or FY2026), clarification is required before updating the chart.
plan.clarification: 어느 연도를 제외할까요? FY2024, FY2025, 아니면 FY2026 중에서 선택해 주세요.
